findings.oracle: json.dumps(prop) round-trips correctly and parsed dict has exact type='string' and description=_PARAM_DESC values; breaks if build_schema_property returns non-serializable or wrong field values
json.dumps(result) round-trips and parsed dict has type='object', properties={}, required=[]; breaks if schema structure is wrong or not JSON-serializable

Replaced crash-triggering test with: (a) test_fallback_characters_are_exactly_correct asserts UNICODE_FALLBACK['status_success']=='\u2713', ['status_error']=='\u2717', ['status_warning']=='\u26a0' against independently known Unicode constants; (b) test_no_fallback_icon_returns_null_qicon asserts _create_fallback_icon for a name absent from both maps returns isNull=True; (c) test_critical_svg_icons_load_and_have_available_sizes asserts six critical SVG icons load non-null with availableSizes()>0. Breaks if fallback characters change, if null branch is removed, or if any critical SVG icon fails to load.

TestCallbackErrorPaths added: ValueError/RuntimeError/OSError from callbacks do not propagate; subsequent callbacks still receive events after a raiser; cursor_offset reads 999 after bad_cb raises; 20-thread concurrent set_document all joins within 10s with no RuntimeError. Breaks if callback exceptions propagate, if subsequent callbacks are silenced, or if state mutation is not committed before dispatch.

TestTypeRegistryEdgeCases added: register_struct/union/alias with builtin name raises HexPatTypeError matching the name; resolve('CycleA') with A->B->A alias cycle returns None without hanging; r2.resolve('IsolatedStruct') returns None (registry isolation); re-registering same name stores latest decl; resolve_primitive on unknown returns None; user_type_names excludes builtins. Breaks if any guard is removed.

Added: empty-context string returns default=-99; base=16 parses 'ff' to exactly 255; base=0 parses '0xFF' to exactly 255; unparseable with no default returns None. Breaks if base-16 parsing or fallback-default logic is removed.
